steps.name: Environment setup (deterministic venv + safe env persistence)
steps.description: Create a deterministic Python venv at /opt/venv if absent, ensure python3-venv package is present, upgrade pip using python -m pip inside the venv and validate success, persist minimal env variables (PORT=8501, PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1) and prepend /opt/venv/bin to PATH in /etc/profile.d/tictactoe_env.sh using sudo tee with a single-quoted heredoc to avoid expanding $PATH at creation time. Use sudo explicitly for privileged operations and chown /opt/venv to the invoking non-root user when SUDO_UID/SUDO_GID are present. Operates in the authoritative workspace path.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-streamlit-app-42509-42518/tic_tac_toe_native"
mkdir -p "$WS"
# ensure python venv support
if ! python3 -c 'import venv' >/dev/null 2>&1; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive sudo apt-get update -q && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive sudo apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv >/dev/null; fi
# create deterministic venv if missing
if [ ! -f /opt/venv/bin/activate ]; then
  sudo rm -rf /opt/venv || true
  python3 -m venv /opt/venv
fi
# validate venv python exists
if [ ! -x /opt/venv/bin/python ]; then echo "venv creation failed: /opt/venv/bin/python missing" >&2; exit 2; fi
# upgrade pip via python -m pip and verify
/opt/venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip >/dev/null
# write safe /etc/profile.d without expanding $PATH at write-time
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/tictactoe_env.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
export PORT=8501
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"
EOF
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/tictactoe_env.sh || true
# ensure /opt/venv ownership allows invoking non-root user to use it
if [ -n "${SUDO_UID:-}" ]; then sudo chown -R "${SUDO_UID}:${SUDO_GID:-${SUDO_UID}}" /opt/venv || true; fi

steps.name: Dependencies installation (venv packages + system deps) with compatibility checks
steps.description: Verify Python and venv python versions, ensure sqlite3 and curl present (install if missing), and install Python dependencies into /opt/venv. Prefer requirements.txt if present; otherwise install conservative Streamlit range (streamlit>=1.20,<2) and pytest. Validate installations by importing and printing versions. Fail fast with clear messages on incompatibility or installation errors.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-streamlit-app-42509-42518/tic_tac_toe_native"
cd "$WS"
# check system python
python3 --version || { echo "python3 not available" >&2; exit 2; }
/opt/venv/bin/python -V >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "/opt/venv python not found, run env-001 first" >&2; exit 3; }
PYVER=$(/opt/venv/bin/python -c 'import sys; print("%d.%d"%(sys.version_info[0],sys.version_info[1]))')
# conservative check: require Python 3.8+ (Ubuntu 24.04 has >=3.11)
major=$(echo "$PYVER" | cut -d. -f1)
if [ "$major" -lt 3 ]; then echo "Unsupported python version: $PYVER" >&2; exit 4; fi
# ensure system deps if missing
need_apt=()
command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || need_apt+=(sqlite3)
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || need_apt+=(curl)
if [ ${#need_apt[@]} -gt 0 ]; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive sudo apt-get update -q && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive sudo apt-get install -y -qq "${need_apt[@]}"; fi
# install python deps into venv
if [ -f "$WS/requirements.txt" ]; then
  /opt/venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-input -r "$WS/requirements.txt"
else
  # conservative constraint to avoid incompatible latest major release
  /opt/venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-input "streamlit>=1.20,<2" pytest
fi
# verify installs and print versions
/opt/venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sys
try:
    import streamlit, pytest
    print('STREAMLIT', getattr(streamlit,'__version__','unknown'))
    print('PYTEST', getattr(pytest,'__version__','unknown'))
except Exception as e:
    print('Dependency import failed:', e, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(5)
PY

steps.name: Validation: start, probe, stop (deterministic pidfile & PGID termination)
steps.description: End-to-end validation that starts the app with a monitored wrapper which writes a pidfile and log, probes localhost:$PORT with curl until responsive, prints evidence on success, then terminates the process group cleanly via PGID and verifies shutdown. Uses conservative timeouts and provides log excerpts on failure. Depends on all prior steps.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/tic-tac-toe-streamlit-app-42509-42518/tic_tac_toe_native"
. /opt/venv/bin/activate
cd "$WS"
export PORT=${PORT:-8501}
PIDFILE=/tmp/tictactoe.pid
LOG=/tmp/tictactoe_streamlit.log
# start monitored wrapper that writes pidfile; use setsid to create new pg
bash -lc "setsid bash -c 'exec >\"${LOG}\" 2>&1; /opt/venv/bin/streamlit run \"$WS/app.py\" --server.enableCORS=false --server.headless=true --server.port=\"$PORT\"' & echo $! > \"${PIDFILE}\"" >/dev/null
# wait for pidfile
for i in {1..20}; do [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] && break || sleep 0.2; done
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then echo "Failed to create pidfile" >&2; exit 2; fi
bg_pid=$(cat "$PIDFILE")
# get PGID reliably
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$bg_pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' || true)
if [ -z "$PGID" ]; then PGID=$bg_pid; fi
# wait up to ~30s for server
ok=1
for i in {1..60}; do
  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -sSf "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=0; break; else sleep 0.5; fi
done
if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then echo "Validation failed: no response on port $PORT (see $LOG)" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" || true; # attempt clean termination
  kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || pkill -f '/opt/venv/bin/streamlit' >/dev/null 2>&1 || kill -TERM "$bg_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true
  exit 3
fi
echo "VALIDATION_OK: http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/ is responding"
# terminate process group cleanly, wait for exit
kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || pkill -f '/opt/venv/bin/streamlit' >/dev/null 2>&1 || kill -TERM "$bg_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
for j in {1..10}; do
  if kill -0 "$bg_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1; then sleep 0.5; else break; fi
done
if kill -0 "$bg_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -KILL "$bg_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true
